name: H2 Single-Variant BTC-to-ETH/XRP Lead-Lag Test

detector_family.reason: The prior selection of k=1.25 did not survive a nine-way family-wise correction, so H2 must carry all nine independent detector streams as one simultaneous family.

single_BTC_feature.formula: B_t = side_t * log(BTC_close_t / BTC_close_(t-5m)) / sqrt(sum_{i=t-239m}^{t} r_i^2)
single_BTC_feature.information_cutoff: all BTC inputs must have timestamps less than or equal to the ETH/XRP confirmation close
single_BTC_feature.missing_timestamp_rule: event is ineligible; never forward-fill or interpolate BTC prices
single_BTC_feature.direction_alignment: multiply BTC return by target-trade side so positive values mean BTC moved in the proposed ETH/XRP direction

single_filter.rule: B_t at or above the 75th percentile of prior eligible events
single_filter.history_stratum: same target symbol and same detector multiplier; long and short pooled after direction alignment
single_filter.if_failed: No nearby BTC lag, cutoff, volatility window, or leading asset may be tried under H2.

trade_rules.entry: next ETH/XRP one-minute bar open after confirmation
trade_rules.regime_change_while_open: irrelevant; preserve original stop, target, and timeout

execution.reason_BTC_funding_unused: BTC is an information feature, not a traded position

inference.method: four-calendar-week circular moving-block max-t bootstrap of weekly sums and counts
inference.reason: Exactly one BTC feature variant is authorized; the max-t family corrects only the nine inherited detector multipliers.

candidate_selection_if_multiple_pass.primary: largest absolute simultaneous 98% lower confidence bound

stopping_rule.if_none_pass: Reject H2 and do not test another BTC lag/cutoff. Preserve H3 order-flow alpha allocation unchanged.
stopping_rule.if_one_passes: Freeze the policy and only then request authorization to open the locked test period.

required_outputs: all event-level BTC features and causal cutoffs
fold, year, target-asset, and side stability tables
absolute and paired nine-policy max-t distributions and bounds
